result.statementWorkload: Selected target and hover candidates are cached/primed to empty strings to isolate handler/rendering work; this does not measure real statement layout or network loading.
result.method: Real browser RAF; modes detail-zoom, focus, pan-detail; 24 sinusoidal wheel-input zoom frames across LOD thresholds; actual requested 600ms focus/fit animations measured through their exact final target and two drained RAFs for final submission/render (10s timeout); 24 native PointerEvent hover positions with exact hit testing; 60 RAF pan inputs per pan mode after eight warm-up draws and a separately recorded cold raster setup; trusted wheel and pointer preflights; all 13574 nodes and 23076 edges loaded, all 13 fields/planned/definitions enabled. Canvas oversized DPR2 uses its full-resolution direct fallback; the experimental scene retains a tiled coverage target and world geometry, and reports any actual Canvas fallback separately. Additional settled-raster latency and final draw costs are reported separately. CPU submission time and browser frame cadence use performance.now after callbacks, including the final drained paint, rather than pre-paint RAF timestamps. No universal-device performance claim.
